summary: Extracting a method value and later calling it must not retain the original receiver as this.

target.notes: A C# instance-method delegate would incorrectly capture the receiver. Store a JS function value independent of the property-reference base.

semantics.this_binding_on_later_plain_call: undefined in strict functions; converted according to callee's thisMode in sloppy functions

caveats: If the function is an arrow, its lexical this is retained independently.
Module/strictness affects the callee's this conversion, not the extraction step.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification Reference Records and EvaluateCall

tests.name: strict detached method gets undefined this
tests.input: const o={m:function(){'use strict'; return this;}}; const f=o.m; console.log(f()===undefined);

tests.name: do not capture object
tests.input: const o={x:1,m:function(){'use strict';return this&&this.x}}; const f=o.m; console.log(f());
